content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element. 2. The claim's effect on the four variables of T-state is exactly the `redo` action in specs/markers/redo.qnt — the position to the post-boundary of the next undone pair, the undone count stepped one forward, the pairs and the bound unchanged. Fail on any diverging element — name it.
content.rationale: The redo effect is where the model's transition meets the variables it moves and the selection it reads; this check forces the claim to answer to the action it is read out of, from the artifact's side, without re-deciding the model.
